description: Relative time humanizer — Turn timestamps into human relative times like '3 hours ago', 'yesterday' or 'in 2 weeks' using Intl.RelativeTimeFormat in any locale, plus the exact calendar-aware breakdown (years, months, days, hours, minutes, seconds), exact_text ('6 hours, 30 minutes ago'), compact form (-6h 30m), delta seconds, direction, and calendar-day difference/label (today, yesterday, tomorrow) in a chosen time zone. Params: ts= one or more ISO 8601 dates or unix seconds/ms, comma-separated (max 50); now= reference time (default current time); tz= IANA zone for calendar days (default UTC); locale= (default en); locales= extra comma list for side-by-side translations; style=long|short|narrow; numeric=auto|always. Offline. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: time_relative
